notes: Reviewed and returned unchanged: every s### and t### id is partitioned exactly once, all twelve units are aligned with both heads inside their arrays, and no unrepresented or added unit is warranted.

The projection supplies no article tokens at all in this verse, so the article rules (19-23, 51, 57, 60) never engage. Both supplied English determiners — our before Father and the before Lord — fall under rule 51's anarthrous clause: our is ἡμῶν's own possessive, and the is a rule 7 helper on κυρίου headed on Lord under rule 17.

s007/s008 are kept split rather than bundled as a phrase: our answers to ἡμῶν and Father to πατρός, each independently recoverable under rule 26. The interlinear bracket "[the] Father" is a gloss convention, not an article token, and rule 12 forbids reading a textual decision into it.
Ἰησοῦ and Χριστοῦ stay separate units rather than sharing one head, per rules 17 and 28.
The supplied to before you rides with ὑμῖν as the dative's case preposition; no article stands in this verse for rule 21 to hand it to, and rule 36 keeps from on ἀπό rather than on any noun.
